name: big-label-maker
description: Web app for designing single-page labels on 8.5" x 11" paper

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run init-db
